_comment: Copy to config.local.json and fill in. Anything set here overrides the same upper-case name in config.py. Unknown keys are reported and ignored.
_comment2: This file is gitignored. Nothing personal should ever be in config.py.
USER_NAME: your name, spoken in the system prompt and confirmations
CITY: your city, for the briefing's weather line
_comment3: Your own words for the recogniser, added to the project's own list in config.py. Your name, your town, the programs you launch by voice: without these, whisper guesses at proper nouns and the app you open every day comes back wrong.
_comment4: The phrase that wakes it, and the variants the recogniser may produce for its last word. The phrase is understood, not matched against a trained model, so any phrase works. The aliases matter when the name is unusual: whisper will not spell it the same way twice.
WHISPER_HINT_EXTRA: your name, your town, the apps you launch by voice
